configuration.title: LPC Support Configuration
configuration.lpc.enableUnusedGlobalVarC: Enable checks for unused global variables. Disabled by default to avoid false positives from LPC inheritance chains and variables shared through headers.
configuration.lpc.enableUnusedParameterC: Enable checks for unused function parameters. Only implementations with a function body are checked, and parameters prefixed with an underscore are ignored. Disabled by default to avoid noise from conventional callback and override parameters.
configuration.lpc.enforceLocalVariableDe: Require local variable declarations at the start of an executable statement or code block. Recent FluffOS versions usually do not require this restriction.
configuration.lpc.searchEfunDefinitionIn: Search the inheritance chain when using Go to Definition on an efun (driver builtin) call. Disabled by default: efun calls return no definition immediately to avoid the delay of traversing the inheritance chain. Enable this only when you override efuns in the inheritance chain rather than in the simulated efun library (simul_efun).
configuration.lpc.enableTypeChecking.des: Enable conservative LPC type-checking diagnostics. When disabled, no lpc.type.* diagnostics are reported.
configuration.lpc.format.indentSize.desc: Indentation width for LPC formatting. Spaces or tabs follow the editor settings.
configuration.lpc.format.printWidth.desc: Target line width for LPC parameter and argument lists. Set to 0 to disable automatic wrapping; nonzero values are treated as 20–400 columns. Macro arguments, comments, and strings are preserved without forced truncation.
configuration.lpc.format.braceStyle.desc: Brace style for LPC formatting. Changes take effect immediately.
configuration.lpc.format.braceStyle.enum: Place opening braces on their own line.
Place opening braces after the declaration or control statement.
configuration.lpc.glm4.apiKey.descriptio: Zhipu AI GLM-4 API key used to generate Javadoc comments.
configuration.lpc.glm4.model.description: GLM-4 model ID. Supports preset or custom model IDs. Presets include: glm-4, glm-4-flash, glm-z1-flash, GLM-4.5-Flash, GLM-4-Flash-250414.
Allow users to select a custom model when generating Javadoc comments.
configuration.lpc.glm4.baseUrl.descripti: Base URL for the GLM-4 API.
configuration.lpc.glm4.alwaysShowModelSe: Show the model selector every time Javadoc comments are generated. When disabled, use the default model directly.
configuration.lpc.glm4.rememberLastModel: Remember the last selected model and prefer it for the next generation.
configuration.lpc.documentation.language: Language for newly generated documentation comments. Existing comment text is preserved.
